About the role:

 Ironclad is hiring a Senior Finance Manager, GYM to lead financial planning, forecasting, and strategic insights for our Sales organization. Reporting to the Senior Director of GTM Finance within the CFO organization, you will serve as a key strategic business partner to Sales leadership and a critical driver of Ironclad’s continued revenue growth.

As Ironclad continues to scale its enterprise and mid-market presence, you will shape GTM investment strategy, support complex sales motions, and enable our next stage of growth through robust financial modeling, operational rigor, and actionable analytics.



What you’ll be doing:

 - Financial Planning & Forecasting: Own the financial model, annual planning, quarterly forecasting, and ARR/bookings reporting across all Sales functions, segmenting by GTM motion (mid-market vs. enterprise).

 - Strategic Business Partnership: Partner directly with the CRO, VP of Business Development, VP of Revenue Operations, and other GTM leaders to evaluate investment opportunities, sales capacity, pipeline coverage, and AE unit economics.

 - Upmarket & Deal Support: Build models that support complex sales motions, deal structuring, and pricing frameworks while driving efficiency across both mid-market and enterprise segments.

 - Headcount & Capacity Planning: Collaborate cross-functionally with People, Ops, and Analytics teams on headcount planning, organizational scaling, territory design, and quota allocation.

 - Dashboards & Systems Optimization: Partner with the BI team to deliver executive-facing dashboards, refine data governance, and automate planning workflows across financial systems as we scale.



What we're looking for:

 - Experience: 6+ years in strategic finance, FP&A, consulting, or investment banking, with direct experience supporting GTM/Sales organizations in high-growth SaaS environments.

 - Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of SaaS business metrics (ARR, Net Retention Rate, LTV/CAC, sales capacity, pipeline hygiene, and incentive comp structures).

 - Cross-Functional Influence: Proven track record of influencing senior leadership and translating complex financial data into actionable strategic guidance for non-finance stakeholders.

 - Technical & Modeling Mastery: Advanced financial modeling skills with hands-on proficiency in Excel. Experience with FP&A platforms (Anaplan, Adaptive, Planful), CRM (Salesforce), ERP (NetSuite), and BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) is strongly preferred.

 - AI & Modern Tooling Proficiency: Familiarity with leveraging AI tools, automated data workflows, or advanced analytics to increase FP&A efficiency, speed up data analysis, and automate forecasting processes.

 - Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
   

Location: San Francisco - Hybrid

THE ROLE

Ironclad is looking for a Sr. Director, Global Sales Strategy and Operations to own the operating infrastructure of the global sales organization: sales planning, pipeline and bookings performance, renewal and expansion execution, partner operations, and business development operations. This is a GTM-first role. You’ll partner as closely with Marketing, Customer Experience, Finance, and the GTM Engineering & Systems team as you do with Sales leadership, because we don’t win by optimizing one function alone.

This is also a data-first, AI-forward role. You’ll shape how Ironclad’s revenue org uses AI internally, in tooling and forecasting, and how our GTM motion adapts as buyers get more AI-savvy themselves. Bring firsthand experience with what AI can already do inside a revenue org, plus a point of view on what’s next.

This is not a ‘keep the lights on’ operations role. You will be responsible for automating away friction in our sales process, moving our team away from repetitive, transactional work and toward the strategic insights that actually move the needle.

This role calls for someone who will challenge sales leadership when the data calls for it: pressure-test plans, flag risk early, push back with evidence, and keep the relationship strong while doing it. This is a role for someone who wants to reshape how the business runs.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

GTM Planning & Strategy

 - Drive annual and long-range planning for the sales org, including new business, renewals, expansion, partners, and BDR, in partnership with Sales leadership and Finance.

 - Own territory design, quota allocation, compensation plan design, and capacity modeling for AE, CAE, BDR, and partner teams.

 - Define and maintain operating rules of engagement across GTM roles, so ownership, handoffs, and coverage stay clear as the business and its markets evolve.

 - Build the operational foundation for Ironclad’s international expansion, adapting planning frameworks, territory models, and cadences so global teams execute with the same rigor as the core business.

Revenue Intelligence & Accountability

 - Simplify and automate our forecasting and pipeline reporting. Your goal is to give leadership one clean, central view of the funnel, freeing up everyone’s time to focus on closing deals rather than managing spreadsheets.

 - Drive accountability to the metrics that matter most: pipeline generation and coverage, net ARR and bookings attainment, and GRR and NDR performance, so the org closes gaps before they turn into missed targets.

 - Curate and lead our operating cadences—forecast reviews, deal inspections, and pipeline councils—ensuring they serve as a platform for real strategic decision-making, not just status updates.

 - In partnership with BI and Revenue leadership, define what gets measured and surfaced, then use that data to improve how the revenue organization operates and performs.

Sales Performance & Revenue Impact

 - Turn trends across the funnel into programs that move the needle: a defined, forecastable expansion motion for the account management team, and renewal operations that deliver consistent GRR and NDR.

 - Build performance programs for partner- and BDR-sourced pipeline, including conversion analysis and enablement feedback, that lift their contribution to bookings.

AI & Transformation Leadership

 - Use AI to supercharge our sales motion. We don’t just want someone to manage tools; we want someone who looks at our current workflow and asks, ‘How can we automate this?’ to make our sellers more effective and our forecasting more accurate.

 - Co-develop Ironclad’s GTM AI strategy as the primary field-side partner to the GTM Engineering & Systems team, so AI investments map to real field needs, with adoption tracked against clear metrics.

Strategic Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

 - Build and lead a high-performing operations team that shapes the business, and serve as a senior thought partner to Sales, Finance, and GTM leadership, translating signals into clear decisions and pushing back when the data calls for it.

 - Present to executive leadership with confidence, turning complex operational narratives into clear, data-backed recommendations for the CRO, CEO, and CFO.

Team Structure

 - This role reports into the VP, Revenue Operations and Enablement. It leads a global sales operations team covering the Americas, EMEA, and APAC regions, along with strategy, planning, and sales programs. Structure and titles will flex based on the candidate and ongoing transitions.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 12+ years of progressive experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Strategy at a high-growth SaaS company.

 - 8+ years of people leadership, including experience managing managers, with a track record of building and developing high-performing ops teams.

 - Genuine AI fluency: you understand how AI tools work in a GTM context, evaluate use cases critically, and drive adoption with conviction, both inside the revenue org and in how the org sells externally. You don’t need to build agents. You need to speak the language and evaluate the ROI.

 - Proven experience leading multi-functional operations portfolios spanning sales ops, renewals, and partnerships, or equivalent scope, globally rather than in a single region.

 - A GTM-first mindset, with experience partnering across Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Finance instead of optimizing for Sales alone.

 - Strong analytical skills: able to build forecasting models, work with complex datasets, and translate data into executive-ready narratives.

 - Deep familiarity with SaaS business mechanics: ARR, GRR, NDR, quota design, and partner economics.

 - Hands-on experience with the full GTM stack, including CRM, revenue intelligence platforms (forecasting, sales engagement, conversation intelligence, etc.), and AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Actively, Glean, Minoa).

 - A trusted, credible voice with sales leadership who can challenge assumptions and push back constructively while keeping the relationship strong.

 - Executive presence: equally effective presenting to front-line managers and C-suite audiences.

 - High ownership, low ego, bias toward action.

+bonus + equity

ROLE OVERVIEW

As the Lifecycle, Attribution & Analytics Owner, you will serve as the strategic architect behind our full-funnel customer journey, multi-touch attribution engine, and core lead management infrastructure. Operating in a high-growth, enterprise B2B SaaS environment, you will own the entire end-to-end lead lifecycle—from initial signal intake and enrichment to lead scoring, inbound routing, and the seamless operational handoff to Sales.

This role requires hands-on Marketo AND Bizible mastery as absolute prerequisites, paired with advanced analytical capability. You will directly manage all technologies, data schemas, and processes that dictate how leads and accounts progress through our GTM funnel while delivering multi-touch attribution models that prove marketing ROI.

Measure and report on pipeline contribution, campaign ROI, velocity, and conversion rates from first touch to closed-won.

 - Lead Scoring, Enrichment & Routing Operations: Architect, test, and continuously optimize our lead and account scoring models (behavioral + demographic). Oversee real-time enrichment pipelines (Leadspace, 6sense, Clearbit/Clay) and automated routing systems (Chili Piper, LeanData) to ensure instant SLA sales handoffs.

 - Sales Alignment & Funnel Handoff: Define and govern the operational boundaries between Marketing and Sales (SDR/BDR/AE teams). Standardize lead status workflows, SLA tracking, recoil/rejection reason logging, and MQL/MQA notification protocols in Salesforce.

 - Signal-Based & ABM Journey Nurturing: Partner with Demand Gen and Sales Ops to build automated account-based engagement tracks powered by intent signals (6sense, G2) and product-assisted growth metrics.

 - Cross-Functional Analytics Enablement: Deliver executive dashboards and actionable pipeline reporting (SQL, Salesforce, Tableau/Looker) to guide growth strategy and budget allocation.




QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience: 5+ years in Marketing Operations or Revenue Operations within an enterprise B2B SaaS environment, with explicit focus on full-funnel lead lifecycle design and attribution.




MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:

 - Marketo & Bizible Expertise (Required): Hands-on, advanced experience with both Marketo AND Bizible is 100% required. Candidates lacking direct experience in either platform will not be considered. Must have a proven track record of scaling enterprise Marketo lifecycle models, Bizible touchpoint mapping, and Marketo-Salesforce CRM sync architectures.

 - Lead Funnel Operations: Hands-on experience configuring and managing lead routing engines (Chili Piper, LeanData), enrichment providers (Leadspace, 6sense), and lead scoring systems.

   - Serve as the technical architect for Marketo, maintaining system performance, global program templates, tokenization, lead scoring pipelines, database hygiene, and CRM integration rules.

   - Automate campaign ops end-to-end—continuously shoring up manual processes, eliminating ticket bottlenecks, and introducing automated QA guardrails for link validation, rendering, and brand compliance.

 - Functional Super-User Enablement:
   
   - Onboard, train, and certify functional admins across business units (e.g., event teams in Goldcast/Splash, content teams in AirOps, web teams in WordPress/GTM) to ensure decentralized execution follows centralized standards.
   
   - Act as the technical escalation point for integrations, schema errors, and platform troubleshooting.

   - Marketo Mastery (Required): Advanced Marketo administration experience is 100% required (Marketo Certification preferred). Candidates without hands-on Marketo expertise will not be considered. Deep technical knowledge of Marketo program architecture, tokenized templates, global forms, deliverability, and Marketo-Salesforce CRM sync management is essential.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Lead Strategic Partnerships Manager to own the launch and execution phases of specific technology partnerships end-to-end. You'll be the operational engine behind the portfolio: taking partnerships from scoped/signed intent through integration, launch, and ongoing management, while keeping the Product/EPD, Marketing, and Sales tracks tied to each deal moving in lockstep.



This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role for someone who thrives on turning ambiguity into structured, on-time delivery. You won't just track work — you'll drive it, unblock it, and make sure every partner launch lands with the internal alignment and external polish it deserves.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own deal execution end-to-end. Drive technology partnerships through their launch and execution lifecycle — from integration, launch moment, and ongoing management. Build and maintain the plans, timelines, milestones, and status tracking that keep each deal on schedule and every stakeholder informed.



Orchestrate cross-functional workstreams. Serve as the connective tissue across Product/EPD, Marketing, and Sales for each partnership. Translate partnership goals into concrete deliverables for each team, coordinate dependencies, run recurring syncs, and ensure product investment, co-marketing motions, and sales enablement achieve agreed upon goals and deliver intended value.



Run launch moments. Coordinate partner launch moments and joint go-to-market activations — aligning messaging, product readiness, co-marketing plans, and enablement so announcements land with maximum impact and minimal fire-drills.



Keep the portfolio visible. Maintain a single source of truth across the partnership portfolio — phase, status, owners, next steps, and risk — and produce clear executive-ready updates that give leadership and cross-functional partners a reliable read on progress.



Drive accountability and unblock. Proactively surface risks, chase down dependencies, and remove blockers before they slip timelines. Hold internal and partner stakeholders to commitments while keeping relationships strong.



Manage partner-facing execution. Support day-to-day coordination with partner counterparts during launch and execution phases, ensuring a smooth, professional experience and clear communication on both sides.



Build the operating system. Help stand up and iterate on the scalable, repeatable playbooks and tiered program structure that let the team support more partners without more chaos — templates, intake and launch processes, and cross-functional engagement models.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6–9 years of experience in technology/ISV partnerships, partner/alliance management, strategic programs, or cross-functional program management — ideally at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company.

 - A demonstrated track record of owning complex, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end and delivering them on time across Product, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders.

 - Strong program and project management instincts — you build structure quickly, sequence dependencies, and keep many moving parts coordinated without dropping details.

 - Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority and keep both internal teams and external partners aligned.

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and a fast-moving environment, bringing order and momentum where processes don't yet exist.

 - A bias toward proactive ownership — you anticipate risks, drive accountability, and make things happen rather than waiting for direction.

 - Familiarity with technology integrations and go-to-market motions (co-marketing, co-selling, enablement); exposure to AI, legal tech, procurement, or the broader enterprise software ecosystem is a plus.

Ironclad is looking for an RVP, Enterprise Sales Leader to help support our rapid scale and make an impact on our revenue goals. The ideal candidate has led a team selling SaaS in the Enterprise space.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Manage daily and weekly activities, pipelines, forecasts, and closed deals to ensure repeatable, predictable, above-quota results based on successful pipeline management.

 - Build, measure, and optimize a repeatable sales process to successfully achieve targeted sales objectives.

 - Recruit, hire, and manage a growing team of experienced Account Executives to achieve individual and company sales targets.

 - Empower your team with scalable systems and repeatable processes to increase AEs' sales skills, product and industry knowledge, and professional habits.

 - Train and assist sales reps in closing complex transactions by teaching best practices in prospecting, managing, and closing opportunities, along with the skills needed to position Ironclad as the industry leader.

 - Create a team culture that is positive, motivating, and performance-driven.

 - Develop specific and targeted goals within each demand team to expand and accelerate revenue opportunities within their unique customer sets.

 - Track and report key growth metrics to assess individual and team performance.

 - Find innovative and creative ways to improve and increase performance.

 - Plan resource allocation, forecast growth, and monitor pipeline.

 - Implement best practices to support consistent and consultative sales and client success processes.

 - Champion practical, AI-enabled selling across the team by identifying workflows that improve account research, prospect prioritization, opportunity management, deal inspection, coaching, forecasting, and rep productivity.

 - Establish clear standards for responsible AI adoption, including data quality, human judgment, customer confidentiality, and appropriate use of AI-generated insights and content.

 - Coach managers and AEs on how to evaluate AI outputs, apply sound sales judgment, and turn AI-assisted insights into measurable actions and better customer experiences.

 - Partner with Sales Operations, Enablement, Marketing, and Product to test, measure, and scale AI-powered tools and processes that improve conversion, cycle time, forecast accuracy, and selling effectiveness.

 - Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role, working collaboratively with the rest of the Sales Leadership Team to get things done.
   
   


REQUIREMENTS

 - 10+ years of experience in SaaS sales, with a minimum of 5 years leading a team in Enterprise.

 - You have closed enterprise business and have a personal history of repeatedly exceeding your past individual contributor quota so you can train AEs on how to be successful in the role.

 - You have great people skills and have shown the ability to recruit, hire, and manage talented people.

 - You're able to build scalable processes, and you have the analytical skills to optimize them over time.

 - You have experience adopting or leading the use of AI-powered sales tools and workflows, with a practical understanding of how AI can improve productivity, pipeline execution, coaching, and forecasting.

 - You can distinguish useful AI-generated insights from unreliable outputs, validate recommendations against source data, and make thoughtful decisions about when human judgment is required.

 - You understand the importance of responsible AI use, including data privacy, security, confidentiality, transparency, and minimizing bias in sales decisions.

 - You blend strategy and execution. You see the larger picture, but you dive into the details to get things done.

 - Highly effective communicator with strong EQ and influencing skills—able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company.

 - Experience using modern sales tools such as LinkedIn, Salesforce, AI-enabled sales applications, and related productivity tools.

 - Eager for a very hands-on role, where you'll be asked to take on and run with a range of projects outside your comfort zone, and learn quickly.

 - Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented, with great follow-through on projects and tasks big and small.

 - Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.



OTE Range: $350,000 - $410,000

The OTE range represents the minimum and maximum of the OTE range for this position based at our San Francisco headquarters. The OTE offered for this position will depend on numerous factors, including individual proficiency, anticipated performance, and the location of the selected candidate. Our OTE is just one component of Ironclad’s competitive total rewards package, which also includes equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), competitive health and wellness benefits, and a commitment to career growth and development.

 - Paid time off - take the time you need, when you need it

 - Monthly stipends for wellbeing, hybrid work, and (if applicable) cell phone use

 - Mental health support through Modern Health, including therapy, coaching, and digital tools

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits (US Employees)

 - And most importantly: the opportunity to help build the company you want to work at
